message:
I had this moment the other night during a surprise blackout. The lights flickered and then went out completely, but instead of panic, I felt a little thrill. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and powered up my phone with a fully charged power bank—yes, I finally remembered to charge it! I even dug out my battery-operated lantern, which lit up the living room like a cozy little campfire. 

For once, I was the one prepared while my neighbors scrambled for candles. It felt good to have a plan and a few supplies ready to go! Who knew being ready could feel so rewarding? 

What about you—do you have a go-to tip for handling power outages?
